content.rendered:
We are looking forward to seeing all of you and starting a new school year. Please click here to view the Middleton Update. The principal’s update is filled with all the information you will need to know for the first day of school and more. 

If you have other questions or corcerns that were not addressed, please call the office at 503-825-5302.
